label: Era II begins
why: After Granada, Columbus and da Gama: Europe's Atlantic powers are at sea, the Italian Wars have begun and the Safavid rise is months away.

realms.name: Kingdom of England
realms.note: Tudor dynasty since Bosworth (1485); holds Calais and the Pale in Ireland.

realms.name: Kingdom of France
realms.note: Court mostly at Blois; holds Milan (Oct 1499) and lordship of Genoa.

realms.name: Duchy of Brittany
realms.ruler: Anne, Duchess of Brittany (Queen of France)
realms.note: Personal union with France through Anne's marriage to Louis XII (Jan 1499); duchy kept its own institutions until 1532.

realms.name: Burgundian Netherlands (Habsburg)
realms.note: The Low Countries part of the Valois Burgundian state, Habsburg since 1477/1482; the Duchy of Burgundy itself went to France.

realms.name: Old Swiss Confederacy
realms.note: De facto free of the Empire after the Swabian War (Peace of Basel, Sep 1499).

realms.name: Crown of Castile
realms.note: Dynastic union with Aragon; itinerant court. Holds Granada (1492), the Canaries and Hispaniola.

realms.name: Crown of Aragon
realms.note: Includes Catalonia, Valencia, Sicily and Sardinia; dynastic union with Castile.

realms.name: Kingdom of Portugal
realms.note: Holds Ceuta, Tangier and Arzila; da Gama back from India (1499).

realms.name: Republic of Venice
realms.note: At war with the Ottomans (1499-1503); holds Cyprus since 1489 and Cremona since 1499.

realms.name: Republic of Florence
realms.note: Fighting to recover Pisa.

realms.name: Republic of Pisa
realms.note: In revolt from Florence 1494-1509.

realms.name: Papal States
realms.note: Cesare Borgia is conquering the Romagna (Imola Nov 1499, Forlì Jan 1500).

realms.name: Kingdom of Naples
realms.note: Aragonese branch; partitioned by France and Spain in 1501.

realms.name: Habsburg Austrian lands
realms.note: Maximilian mostly resides at Innsbruck; Vienna recovered from Hungary in 1490; also holds Tyrol since 1490.

realms.name: Kingdom of Bohemia
realms.note: Personal union with Hungary since 1490.

realms.name: Kingdom of Hungary
realms.note: Holds Belgrade and the Bosnian banates of Jajce and Srebrenik.

realms.name: Duchy of Bavaria-Landshut
realms.note: Line dies out 1503 (Landshut War of Succession).

realms.name: Duchy of Württemberg
realms.note: Duchy since 1495; lines reunited 1482.

realms.name: Landgraviate of Hesse
realms.note: Hesse-Marburg reunited with Kassel on William III's death (Feb 1500).

realms.name: Electorate of Saxony (Ernestine)
realms.note: Wettin lands split at Leipzig (1485).

realms.name: Duchy of Saxony (Albertine)
realms.note: Albertine share from the Partition of Leipzig (1485).

realms.name: Free Imperial City of Cologne
realms.note: Imperial city status confirmed 1475.

realms.name: Free City of Lübeck
realms.note: Leading Hanseatic city.

realms.name: Duchy of Pomerania
realms.note: Reunited under Bogislaw X (1478).

realms.name: Kingdom of Denmark (Kalmar Union)
realms.note: Hans holds all three Nordic crowns 1497-1501; Gotland is Danish.

realms.name: Kingdom of Sweden
realms.ruler: John (Hans), crowned 1497; Sten Sture the Elder sidelined
realms.note: Union with Denmark restored 1497; Swedish revolt 1501.

realms.name: Teutonic Order in Prussia
realms.note: Polish fief since the Second Peace of Thorn (1466).

realms.name: Livonian Order
realms.note: Dominant in Riga after the Peace of Wolmar (1491).

realms.name: Kingdom of Poland
realms.note: Gained Royal Prussia (1466); Mazovia partly a fief.

realms.name: Grand Duchy of Lithuania
realms.note: War with Muscovy resumes in 1500.

realms.name: Grand Principality of Moscow
realms.note: Annexed Novgorod (1478) and Tver (1485); end of the Horde yoke (Ugra, 1480).

realms.name: Pskov Republic
realms.note: Annexed by Muscovy 1510.

realms.name: Grand Principality of Ryazan
realms.note: Annexed by Muscovy 1521.

realms.name: Khanate of Kazan
realms.note: Muscovite protectorate since 1487.

realms.name: Great Horde
realms.note: Destroyed by Crimea in 1502.

realms.name: Khanate of Astrakhan
realms.note: Separate khanate since c.1460s.

realms.name: Crimean Khanate
realms.note: Ottoman vassal since 1475/1478.

realms.name: Shaybanid Uzbeks
realms.note: Invading Transoxiana; takes Bukhara and Samarkand during 1500.

realms.name: Kazakh Khanate
realms.note: Founded c.1465 by Kerei and Janibek.

realms.name: Moghul Khanate
realms.ruler: Mahmud Khan (west; Ahmad Alaq in the east)

realms.name: Dughlat realm of Kashgar and Yarkand
Timurid Sultanate of Herat
realms.note: Holds Khorasan and Khwarazm.

realms.name: Timurid principality of Samarkand
realms.note: Falls to Shaybani in 1500.

realms.name: Timurid principality of Kabul
realms.note: Taken by the Arghuns 1502, by Babur 1504.

realms.name: Timurid principality of Fergana
realms.ruler: Babur (sharing Fergana with his brother Jahangir)
realms.note: Babur's base before his loss of Fergana (1500-1501).

realms.name: Ottoman Empire
realms.note: At war with Venice; Lepanto taken Aug 1499.

realms.name: Beylik of Dulkadir
realms.note: Buffer between Ottomans and Mamluks.

realms.name: Aq Qoyunlu
realms.ruler: Alvand (Tabriz), against Sultan Murad and Muhammadi Mirza
realms.note: Fragmented by succession wars; formally split between Alvand and Murad in 1500.

realms.name: Safavid order
realms.note: Left Lahijan Aug 1499; wintering at Arjuvan; takes Tabriz July 1501.

realms.name: Shirvanshahs
realms.note: Killed by Ismail in late 1500.

realms.name: Kingdom of Kartli
realms.note: Successor of the Georgian kingdom split in 1490.

realms.name: Republic of Ragusa
realms.note: Pays Ottoman tribute.

realms.name: Principality of Moldavia
realms.note: Pays Ottoman tribute but rules itself; beat Poland at Codrii Cosminului (1497).

realms.name: Mamluk Sultanate
realms.note: Four sultans 1498-1501; Qansuh al-Ghawri from 1501.

realms.name: Kingdom of Hormuz
realms.note: Portuguese vassal from 1507/1515.

realms.name: Lodi Sultanate of Delhi
realms.note: Lodi dynasty since 1451; annexed Jaunpur (1479-1494); Agra founded 1504.

realms.name: Bahmani Sultanate
realms.ruler: Mahmud Shah Bahmani (Qasim Barid in power)
realms.note: A shell around Bidar; provinces independent since 1490.

realms.name: Adil Shahi Sultanate of Bijapur
realms.note: Independent since 1490.

realms.name: Nizam Shahi Sultanate of Ahmadnagar
realms.note: Independent since 1490.

realms.name: Imad Shahi Sultanate of Berar
realms.note: Independent since 1490.

realms.name: Vijayanagara Empire
realms.ruler: Narasimha Raya II (regent Tuluva Narasa Nayaka)
realms.note: Saluva dynasty, real power with Narasa Nayaka.

realms.name: Zamorin of Calicut
realms.note: Received da Gama (1498); clashes with Cabral in late 1500.

realms.name: Malla kingdom of Kantipur
realms.note: The Malla realm split into several kingdoms after 1482.

realms.name: Rinpungpa
realms.note: Dominates central Tibet; occupied the Lhasa area from 1498.

realms.name: Phagmodrupa
realms.note: Nominal rulers of Tibet, overshadowed by the Rinpungpa.

realms.name: Northern Yuan
realms.note: Reunifying the eastern Mongols; court among the Chahar.

realms.name: Ashikaga shogunate
realms.ruler: Shogun Ashikaga Yoshizumi (kanrei Hosokawa Masamoto in power); Emperor Go-Tsuchimikado
realms.note: Sengoku period; central authority limited to the Kinai.

realms.name: Ōuchi clan
realms.note: Shelters the deposed shogun Yoshitane from 1499.

realms.name: Ōgigayatsu Uesugi
realms.note: Holds Sagami through vassals such as the Miura.

realms.name: Ise (later Hōjō)
realms.note: Took Izu (1493) and Odawara (1495).

realms.name: Đại Việt (Later Lê)
realms.note: Annexed Vijaya in 1471.

realms.name: Champa (Panduranga)
realms.note: Rump Cham realm in the south after 1471.

realms.name: Kingdom of Cambodia
realms.note: Court left Angkor in the 15th century.

realms.name: Toungoo
realms.note: Breaks from Ava in 1510.

realms.name: Sultanate of Malacca
realms.note: Falls to Portugal 1511.

realms.name: Majapahit (Daha)
realms.note: Rump Majapahit after the loss of Trowulan.

realms.name: Sultanate of Demak
realms.note: Founded c.1475-1478.

realms.name: Maynila
realms.note: Pre-Hispanic polity at the Pasig mouth.

realms.name: Sultanate of Ternate
realms.ruler: Zainal Abidin or Bayan Sirrullah (succession c.1500)

realms.name: Wattasid Morocco
realms.note: Wattasid sultans since 1472.

realms.name: Songhai Empire
realms.note: Askia since 1493; Sonni Ali took Timbuktu (1468) and Djenne.

realms.name: Mali Empire
realms.note: Reduced to the Mande heartland and the Gambia.

realms.name: Sultanate of Bornu
realms.note: Capital Ngazargamu founded c.1480; Kanem still under the Bulala.

realms.name: Bulala Kanem
realms.note: Lost Njimi to Bornu c.1507.

realms.name: Kingdom of Kongo
realms.note: Baptised 1491.

realms.name: Sultanate of Kilwa
realms.note: Sacked by the Portuguese 1505.

realms.name: Sultanate of Adal
realms.ruler: Sultan Muhammad ibn Azhar ad-Din (Emir Mahfuz of Zeila)

realms.name: Mexica Triple Alliance
realms.note: At its widest extent.

realms.name: Maní (Tutul Xiu)
realms.note: One of the Yucatec kuchkabalob after Mayapan's fall.

realms.name: Inca Empire (Tawantinsuyu)
realms.note: Took Chimor c.1470 and Quito under Topa Inca.

realms.name: Republic of Genoa
realms.ruler: Louis XII of France (as lord of Genoa)
realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised. Under French lordship 1499–1512.

realms.name: Duchy of Milan
realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised. French-held since September 1499; Ludovico Sforza retakes it briefly in February 1500.

realms.name: Gaelic Irish lordships
realms.ruler: Gaelic lords; English Lordship under the 8th Earl of Kildare as Lord Deputy
realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

nantes.note: Duchy in personal union with the French crown through Anne of Brittany.

dublin.note: Lordship of Ireland; the Earl of Kildare governs as Lord Deputy.

algiers.note: Algiers ruled by local notables and the Tha'aliba Arabs under loose Zayyanid suzerainty; Spanish Peñón from 1510.

milan.note: Louis XII entered Milan 6 Oct 1499; Ludovico Sforza briefly retook it Feb-Apr 1500.

genoa.note: Genoa submitted to Louis XII in 1499 under a French governor, keeping its own councils.

palermo.note: Kingdom of Sicily under the Crown of Aragon.

cologne.note: Free imperial city; the archbishop-elector resides in Bonn.

bern.note: Canton of Bern, member of the Confederacy.

stockholm.note: Under King Hans of the Kalmar Union 1497-1501.

oslo.note: Norway in union under the Danish king.

konigsberg.note: Order's seat since 1457, a Polish fief.

riga.note: City shared between archbishop and Order; the Order dominant after 1491.

sarai.note: Ruined site in the Great Horde's pastures.

tabriz.note: Held by Alvand; Ismail takes it July 1501.

shiraz.note: Held by a rival Aq Qoyunlu prince.

isfahan.note: Held by a rival Aq Qoyunlu prince.

samarkand.note: Changes hands repeatedly in 1500 (Shaybani, then Babur).

urgench.note: Khwarazm under Herat's governors until Shaybani (1505).

lahore.note: Under the Lodi governor Tatar Khan / Daulat Khan Lodi.

jaunpur.note: Annexed by the Lodis; Sharqi revival crushed 1494.

gulbarga.note: Disputed among Bahmani successors; usually counted with Bijapur.

karakorum.note: Steppe under Dayan Khan's Northern Yuan.

kyoto.note: Shogunal capital; Hosokawa Masamoto holds real power.

kamakura.note: Sagami under the Ōgigayatsu Uesugi and their Miura vassals; Hōjō take Kamakura 1512.

hakata.note: Ōuchi control, contested by the Ōtomo and Shōni.

angkor.note: Abandoned as capital but Cambodian territory.

trowulan.note: Inland East Java between rump Majapahit (Daha) and the rising coastal sultanates.

manila.note: Pre-Hispanic Maynila, said to be under Bruneian influence.

kanem.note: Njimi region held by the Bulala until Bornu's reconquest c.1507.

great_zimbabwe.note: Site abandoned; plateau contested between Torwa and Mutapa.

azcapotzalco.note: Tepanec city ruled under the Mexica since 1428.

mayapan.note: Ruined since c.1441; province attribution uncertain.

havana.note: Taíno and Ciboney chiefdoms of Cuba, no state; not yet colonised.

salvador.note: Tupinambá, no state; Cabral lands in Brazil in April 1500.

quebec.note: St Lawrence Iroquoian Stadacona, no state.

new_orleans.note: Mississippian and Plaquemine peoples, no state.

open_questions: Milan: French since Oct 1499, but Ludovico Sforza retook the city 5 Feb 1500 until Novara (Apr 1500); the date falls in the French interval. Milan is listed as ended though the Sforza return 1512-1535.
Genoa: counted as French-held (1499-1506 French lordship with own councils); could instead be the Republic of Genoa as a French vassal.
Nantes/Brittany: personal union with France, listed as Brittany under a French overlord.
Stockholm: Sweden under King Hans 1497-1501 is listed as a Swedish realm with Denmark as overlord; the Kalmar Union may be modelled as one realm.
Burgundy id is reused for the Habsburg Burgundian Netherlands; the Duchy of Burgundy proper is French.
Castile and Aragon are listed separately (dynastic union only); a run may count them as Spain.
Aq Qoyunlu split between Alvand, Murad and Muhammadi Mirza; Tabriz, Isfahan, Shiraz and Baghdad are all given to one aq_qoyunlu realm.
Samarkand: Sultan Ali Mirza held it on 1 Jan 1500 per most chronologies; Shaybani's capture is dated variously to spring-summer 1500.
Kamakura, Karakorum, Trowulan, Manila, Mayapan, Great Zimbabwe, Kanem, Gulbarga, Urgench and Algiers have uncertain holders (see notes).
Regnal names marked uncertain: Lan Xang (Somphou/Visoun), Cambodia, Champa, Mali, Mrauk U, Tlemcen, Ternate, Mogadishu, Malwa (Ghiyath Shah's deposition date 1500/1501).

Id harmonisation: Genoa and Milan are carried as French-held states (1499–1500) rather than ended; Gaelic Ireland, the Iroquois, Mossi, Oman, Tondo, Ajuran, Jaffna, Khandesh, Lucca, Montferrat, Riga, Samudra Pasai, K'iche' and Sicily were added as still standing. The Safavid order uses persia (one id for Safavid, Afsharid, Zand and Qajar Iran); Maní (Xiu) uses maya.
Shaybanid Uzbeks keep uzbek_khanate, treated as the same state as Abu'l-Khayr's khanate and the later Khanate/Emirate of Bukhara (decision: one continuous Uzbek state at Bukhara).
